headline: DSE and AFRINEX Sign MoU to Promote Cross-Border Investment
summary: The Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange and Mauritius-based AFRINEX signed a memorandum of understanding to promote cross-border investment, market cooperation, future dual listings and wider investor access.
why: Stock exchange partnerships can open new listing and investment channels across African markets. Dual listings and cross-border access can broaden liquidity for investors in smaller frontier markets.
